items.title: Charge ki quantization (q = Ne) aur electrostatics (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 9 opening (PDF 192-193).

blocks.text: Hum jaante hain ke electron par charge ki miqdar (magnitude) proton ke charge ke barabar hai. Proton par charge e+ aur electron par e- hai. Is ki qeemat e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C hai, jahan C (coulomb) charge ki SI unit hai. Yeh charge e ab tak daryaft hone wala sab se chhota azaad charge hai.

Bari miqdar ke charges kisi jism par electrons jor kar ya nikal kar banaye jate hain. Chunke e woh kam se kam charge hai jo kisi zarre par ho sakta hai, charge ki har miqdar q, e ka poora mazrab (integer multiple) hai:

blocks.title: Charge ki quantization
blocks.text: q = Ne, jahan N poora adad (integer) hai. Charge sirf electronic charge e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C ke poore mazrabon mein aata hai.

blocks.title: Electrostatics
blocks.text: Electrostatics aaram mein (at rest) electric charges ke mazahir aur khusoosiyat ka mutala hai. Jab charges harkat mein hon to ise electric current kehte hain.

Charles de Coulomb (1736-1806): science mein Coulomb ka bara hissa electrostatics aur magnetism ke shobe mein tha. Apni zindagi mein unhon ne maaddon ki mazbooti (strength of materials) bhi parkhi aur shehteeron (beams) par asar karne wali forces maloom kin, yun structural mechanics ke shobe mein hissa dala. Ergonomics ke shobe mein un ki tehqeeq ne bunyadi samajh di ke log aur janwar kaam behtareen tareeqe se kaise kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kya kisi zarre par 2.5 x 10^-19 C ya 3.2 x 10^-19 C ka charge mumkin hai (MCQ 9.2)? 100 A h (ampere-hour) wali battery kitna charge de sakti hai (short question 9.3)?
blocks.explanation: Charge e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C ka poora mazrab hona chahiye. 3.2 x 10^-19 C = 2e mumkin hai (option b); 2.5 x 10^-19 C 1.56e hoga, poora adad nahi, to mumkin nahi. 100 A h battery ek ghante tak 100 A de sakti hai: Q = It = 100 A x 3600 s = 3.6 x 10^5 C.

items: e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C sab se chhota azaad charge hai; ajsaam electrons jor kar ya nikal kar charge hote hain; q = Ne, N poora adad (charge ki quantization).
Electrostatics: aaram mein charges; harkat mein charges electric current banate hain.
